sec.title: August 28 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 298)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 28** across American network radio, BBC Radio 4, and syndication, Charlie Ruggles hosting quiz stunts on *A Barrel of Fun* for Rem Cough Syrup, modern short fiction on *Author's Studio*, three patriotic service dramas on *Proudly We Hail* for US Army Recruiting, and Fred Waring's choral arrangement of Hoagy Carmichael's *Washboard Blues* (1941–1975):
